entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. A VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and email address to pull up the order?
Sarah Jenkins. s.jenkins@email.com.

Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 26th. To help me understand the situation, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue. I just changed my mind.
I see. So to confirm, the device is working as expected, but you've decided you don't want to keep it?
Correct. It was a bit of an impulse buy and I just don't use it. I'd like to return it.

I appreciate the clarification, Sarah. Looking at your order details and our policy, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 13 days ago. For this specific device, we have a strict 10-day return window from the day of delivery, mainly for hygiene reasons and because the device activation links the hardware to a user's account.
You're kidding. Ten days? So what, I'm just out the money?
Because it's past that 10-day window, I am unable to process a return for a refund. However, you're not out of options.
Oh, great. I can't wait to hear this.

We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform we set up specifically for situations like this, allowing customers to sell their gently used gear to others in the VeloFit community. The Pulse monitors are in high demand there.
So you want me to sell it myself. Wonderful.

It's a very secure and popular option, and most sellers are able to recoup a significant portion of their original purchase price. It’s a much better alternative than having it sit unused. I can email you a direct link to the resale marketplace page with instructions.
Fine. Whatever. Send me the link. I guess it’s better than nothing.
Of course. I've just sent that email to the address on file. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a good day.
